summary.text: Myriad Fusion Ghost Dragon Sword is Fang Yuan's immortal killer move. Countless ghost dragons gather into one enormous pitch-black dragon marked soul sword.

claims.text: At Infallible blessed land, after myriad ghost sword dragon fails to pass Li Huang’s verdant sun flame cloak, Fang Yuan calls this the consecutive move of myriad ghost sword dragon. It forms within a few breaths, floats with its tip toward Li Huang, and does not move until Fang Yuan strikes it with Luo Po seal. The soul sword then stabs forward. Li Huang hesitates. The speed is astonishing and he could still dodge with his own speed, but he cannot dodge: he has to face it head-on. It pierces through him. The flames subside, his face turns pale, and he collapses dead. Fang Yuan says Li Huang dared to face the combined power of both moves.

Counting the first use of myriad ghost sword dragon, a later myriad sword ghost dragon use, and this move, about ten thousand of Fang Yuan’s soul path dao marks are expended. One activation of myriad ghost sword dragon expends four thousand. He does not have that many soul path dao marks yet and substitutes transformation path dao marks. The move can kill Li Huang who possessed verdant sun flame cloak, but the cost is extremely high. Permanently expending dao marks reduces foundation. The soul sword’s speed is not outstanding and can be dodged easily. Fang Yuan used it because Li Huang was protecting Hairy Foot Mountain and could not casually dodge.

He prepares it again against Chen Yi. Even Li Huang had perished, and Chen Yi has no confidence facing it. Karma relocation teleports the soul sword just as it nears karma divine tree. Fang Yuan’s connection becomes negligible, as if the move were worlds apart from him. The move is based on myriad ghost sword dragon and carries the trait of enslavement path, so a trace of connection remains even if it is teleported over ten thousand li. A little beyond that distance, the killer move collapses and the backlash would make him cough blood. He does not dare use it again while karma divine tree can teleport his methods. He lacks winter coat and reverse flow protection seal, and his defenses are weaker than Li Huang’s. The previous use did not inflict backlash.

Fang Yuan charges with this move again. The enormous soul sword pierces Chen Yi and its remaining force strikes Hairy Foot Mountain. Chen Yi dies. The mountain disintegrates, but Infallible blessed land still stands.
